[[File:Sandbuzzer-aotc.png|thumb|Two sand-buzzers at the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]] with [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]]' [[Zephyr-G swoop/Legends|Zephyr-G swoop]] between them.]]
A '''sand-buzzer''' was a security device that emitted an electronic field to drive away small burrowing pest animals, such as [[Scurrier/Legends|scurriers]].<ref name="SWI60">{InsiderCite|61|Inside Attack of the Clones|Inside ''Attack of the Clones''}}</ref>

Commonly employed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], many [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]], including the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars family's farm]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>, had sand-buzzers surrounding the property, particularly around the sunken walls of the homestead courtyards.
